integrity: All local stiffness/mass matrices, symbolic exact tests, root bracket and negative Green-matrix entry are provided and independently reproducible in the accompanying proof script. Priority comparison against a relevant 2021 thesis is limited by inaccessible full text; independent review not performed.
scientific_limitations: The exact threshold applies only to the one-parameter, symmetric, three-element-per-axis tensor-product mesh with degree-two Gauss-Lobatto quadrature, constant diffusion, homogeneous Dirichlet data, and exact arithmetic. It does not prove sharp conditions on general graded meshes, nor any property of time stepping.
title: Sharp inverse-positivity transition for a symmetrically graded \(Q^2\) spectral-element square
